exposure: soft silicone antimicrobial occlusive foam silver-impregnated dressing
cohort: 375 women aged 18-45 years undergoing a primary low-transverse caesarean section
finding: While not statistically significant, the use of a silver-impregnated dressing in women undergoing a primary low-transverse caesarean section resulted in a 50% reduction in the rate of SSI compared to a standard gauze dressing.
